### The Shalom of God
Author: Mike DeVries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-march-22-2007-11532185.html
Passage: Mark 5:34
Points:
- After twelve years of physical agony, financial ruin, and religious ostracism, a desperate woman reached out to Jesus.
- Believing even a touch of His garment could heal her, she grasped the fringe of His robe and was instantly restored.
- Jesus stopped the moving crowd to seek out the individual whose faith had drawn power from Him.
- In telling her to go in peace, Jesus granted her biblical shalom—complete wholeness, freedom, and life restoration.
- Believers are invited to bring their broken places to God and experience His holistic redemption.

### A Touch of the Master’s Hem
Author: Linda Gray
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/a-touch-of-the-masters-hem-encouragement-cafe-august-24.html
Passage: Luke 8:48
Points:
- Exhausted by failed treatments and isolated as ceremonially unclean, an afflicted woman slipped through the press of people to reach Jesus.
- Seeing room at Christ's feet beneath the crowd, she reached down intentionally to touch the hem of His robe.
- Instead of meeting reprimand for her uncleanness, she received compassion as Jesus called her "daughter" and affirmed her faith.
- While the surrounding multitude merely brushed against Jesus out of curiosity, she came on a purposeful mission to encounter Him.
- Christians are called to move beyond casual surface interactions with Christ and earnestly seek the Healer Himself.

### The Compassion Of Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/compassion-christ
Passage: Mark 5:30
Points:
- Jesus' perception of power going out from Him while asking who touched Him illustrates His united divine and human natures.
- Although superstitious ideas may have prompted the woman to touch His cloak, Jesus instructed her that faith in Him was the true source of healing.
- By calling her "daughter," Jesus addressed her with intimate familial tenderness and dispelled her fear.
- God's supreme authority and power are always accompanied by deep gentleness toward those who place their trust in Him.
